notes: Update button lights up when a new version is out (checked at every start and every 2 hours, no more 5-minute delay). Signed in: your YouTube profile picture and name in the top right and in the Settings. Preview: downloading a small copy is the standard now, streaming is an option in the Settings. Frame: 4:3 instead of 3:4, plus Custom – any shape, pull corners and sides or type the size in px. Tabs that can't be used are hidden (Volume for GIFs, Frame for audio).
